blockers.title: 'Copia equipaggi' silently destroys an already-composed session (crews, placements, boat links, Mezzi) with one tap and no confirmation
blockers.location: src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx:2122-2133 (button enabled whenever not busy), :1290-1317 (copyPreviousCrews commits the copied plan as a full replacement); src/domain/crews.ts:142-202
blockers.scenario: In Domenica AM, compose two crews: [s1,s2] on RS Quest 7 and [s3,s4] on Mezzi. Tap the secondary 'Copia equipaggi' (Sabato PM had one crew [s1,s3]). The probe (probe-domain.ts, copyOverExisting) shows the saved plan becomes one unassigned crew [s1,s3]. Both current crews are deleted, s2 and s4 go back to the pool, the boat-7 link and the Mezzi destination are lost, and reportedRemovals is [], so no dialog appears. Worse, if the previous session has no crews, copiedPlan.crews is [] and every current crew, including crews holding people, is deleted and the page drops back to 'Prepara la sessione'. There is no Undo. Every copy test starts from an empty target session (CrewManagement.test.tsx:1478-1619), so this path is untested.
blockers.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §1 ('confirm destructive deletion'; no generic Undo), §7.3 ('shows an informational post-copy list only when changes occurred'); 07_PAGE_CHANGELOG P14 (a crew holding people must never be deletable by a single tap: the 2026-09-20 empty-crew delete-control rule)
blockers.suggestedFix: Offer the copy only when the target session has no crew members or boat links, or require a confirmation that names what will be replaced. Refuse or no-op when the previous session has no crews. Add a component test that starts from a composed target session.

importantFindings.title: Save errors are invisible in boat mode; choosing a crew that already has a boat and then a blue boat fails silently
importantFindings.location: src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx:2147-2154 (the saveError alert renders only in the non-boat branch), :1617-1653 (any crew can be selected), src/domain/crews.ts:421
importantFindings.scenario: Open 'Apri barche della sessione'. Tap Equipaggio 1, which already has RS Quest 2 (its button is enabled and the status says 'scegli una barca blu'), then tap a blue boat. assignAvailableSessionBoat throws 'Crew already has a boat', the error is caught and setSaveError(true) runs, but boat mode renders no error, so nothing visibly happens. Any real persistence failure in boat mode (toggling a boat's outing) is also silent. The error only appears later, out of context, at the top of the workspace, and has no retry action.
importantFindings.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §1 (show honest save, error and retry state; keep feedback near the affected crew), §10 (routine recoverable errors stay in context with retry), §7.3 (select a crew without a boat)
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Render the save-error alert in boat mode too, next to the strip. Disable or explain selecting a crew that already has a boat, or support reassignment by unlinking first. Offer an explicit retry, or keep the error near the triggering control.

importantFindings.title: The crew destination popup uses different, colour-only boat states from the session strip
importantFindings.scenario: Session strip: grey means unavailable, green means assigned, blue means available. In the crew destination popup a boat assigned to another crew is shown muted grey, an unavailable boat red, and the crew's own boat blue, never green. Each button shows only the model mark and number, and its accessible name ('Assegna equipaggio N a RS Quest 2') carries no state. Grey therefore means 'assigned' in one control and 'unavailable' in the next, and the state is conveyed by colour and disabled opacity alone.
importantFindings.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §7.3 ('The compact destination popup uses the same states and order'), §1 (colour only as reinforcement, always with text or icon); 07_PAGE_CHANGELOG P15 (grey/green/blue legend)
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Reuse the strip's state mapping (and ideally the unused getSessionBoatStates) in the popup, and add a short text or icon state cue plus the state in the accessible name.

importantFindings.title: The invariant checker cannot see capacity or slot corruption: a D2 crew with three students passes validateCourseState
importantFindings.location: src/domain/invariants.ts:16-72 (snapshot has no course family, crew capacity or member positions), :376-459
importantFindings.scenario: Probe (invariantGapD2ThreeStudentCrew): take buildD2FullWeekScenario() and move one student from crew[1] into crew[0] in sat-pm, so a D2 crew has 3 students. validateCourseState returns []. Crews over capacity, duplicate or out-of-range member slots, and non-contiguous crew positions are equally invisible. Only readCrewPlan/readCrewHistory reject them at runtime (by throwing and disabling the whole page), so check:domain and check:full-week cannot detect this corruption class.
importantFindings.specReference: AGENTS.md §11 (detect impossible/corrupt states where feasible); 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §7.1 (D2–D5 fixed at two), §11
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Add course family/level, crew capacity and member positions to CourseStateSnapshot. Report members > capacity, D2–D5 crews > 2, and duplicate or out-of-range slots. Add a table-driven invariant test.

qolFindings.title: Size and group-repeat warnings count only students, so a 3-person crew with a volunteer gets the two-person size rule and misses the whole-crew rule
qolFindings.scenario: D1 crew with XS and S students plus one volunteer (a 3-person crew). getCrewWarnings returns size:red (probe threePersonCrewWithVolunteerSizeWarning). An identical 2-student-plus-same-volunteer crew seen more than 3 sessions ago is only a yellow pair warning, not the red whole-crew repeat.
qolFindings.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §7.4 ('For two-person size combinations… Do not infer unlisted size warnings'; 'For crews of three or more, an identical previous whole crew is red')
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Ask the owner whether volunteers count toward crew size for warnings, then decide on the total member count explicitly and cover it with a table test.

qolFindings.title: The A terra order is random after every reload
qolFindings.scenario: Place Anna, then Bruno, then Carlo A terra and reload. The list, the land-index swap semantics and the summary image's A terra group come back in UUID order, not placement or name order.
qolFindings.specReference: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §7.2/§7.5 (A terra group in summary), §10 (reload preserves state)
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Persist a position column for landAssignments, or sort A terra deterministically by display name.

qolFindings.title: Tested canonical crew helpers are dead code; the UI reimplements boat state and warning severity inline
qolFindings.scenario: getSessionBoatStates, getCrewWarningSummary, getBoatCrewWarnings, formatCrewAnnouncement, getEvenCrewTargets and getCrewSizeStatus have unit tests but no production caller. getCrewSizeStatus still encodes 0.2.0 semantics (flexible crews are always complete and canAdd, ignoring capacity). The tests protect these helpers, not the inline logic the UI actually runs; CR-3 is a drift that this hides.
qolFindings.specReference: AGENTS.md §10 (derive UI from canonical domain truth)
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Route the UI's boat-state and warning-severity logic through the domain helpers, and delete or update the stale helpers (getCrewSizeStatus, getEvenCrewTargets).

qolFindings.title: The summary PNG lists a selected but unavailable, unassigned boat as a free boat
qolFindings.scenario: A boat is selected for the outing and later marked unavailable, with no crew on it. The exported image shows it under 'Barche ed equipaggi vuoti' as 'Barca libera' with no unavailable cue.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Skip unavailable boats in the empty-boat group, or label them 'Non disponibile'.

qolFindings.title: 'Equipaggi pieni' is not shown when the only crew with room is the selected volunteer's own crew
qolFindings.scenario: A volunteer is in crew 1, which has room, and every other crew is full. The popup lists crew 1, disabled as the current crew, and does not say 'Equipaggi pieni', although no other crew can accept the volunteer.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Compute 'full' over the crews that are eligible targets, excluding the person's current crew.
